description: Boundary fixture: 200.1 m car carrier under the Melbourne representative towage-demand rule. Tests that the helper produces a stable result just above the legacy threshold value.
model_note: Representative tug-demand estimate ONLY. NOT an operational towage requirement. NOT a substitute for the Port of Melbourne Harbour Master's Directions (Edition 13.1, September 2023, §3.21).

expected.reasoning: Melbourne band 170-250 m yields n_tugs=2. Vessel-type-floor for Car carrier is 2. Same result as B1_pre_threshold and B1_at_threshold.

boundary_role: value-plus-epsilon (the case the legacy `loa > 200` rule INCLUDED). Behaviour preserved under the new rule — vessels that were already towage_required=true remain so. The new rule does NOT silently flip any current-true vessel to false.
